registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Global control register. Firmware-visible enable, fault-clear pulse, and requested operating mode.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Enable the active-aerodynamics controller and allow request/command generation when other safety conditions are satisfied.

fields.name: CLEAR_FAULT
fields.description: Write-one pulse to request clearing of the latched fault state. The pulse is consumed by the safety monitor.

fields.name: OPERATING_MODE
fields.description: Requested operating mode. Readback reflects the current operating mode reported by the safety monitor.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved. Reads as zero.

registers.name: SPEED_WINDOW_MIN
registers.description: Minimum valid vehicle speed in m/s.

fields.name: SPEED_MIN_MPS
fields.description: Lower speed bound for controller operation. Valid operating envelope is intended for 20-55 m/s unless firmware overrides this range.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved. Reads as zero.

registers.name: SPEED_WINDOW_MAX
registers.description: Maximum valid vehicle speed in m/s.

fields.name: SPEED_MAX_MPS
fields.description: Upper speed bound for controller operation.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved. Reads as zero.

registers.name: ACTUATOR_BOUNDS
registers.description: Minimum and maximum actuator command bounds used by safety supervision and command clamping.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MIN
fields.description: Minimum allowed actuator command value.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MAX
fields.description: Maximum allowed actuator command value.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_CFG
registers.description: Timeout and model request freshness configuration.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES
fields.description: Age threshold in clock cycles before stale-data or timeout fault is latched.

fields.name: MODEL_REQ_TTL
fields.description: Request-to-response time-to-live used by freshness policy and request tracking.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Live status and latched fault summary.

fields.name: FAULT_LATCHED
fields.description: Latched fault state. Remains asserted until reset or explicit firmware clear action is accepted by the safety logic.

fields.name: SAFETY_INHIBIT
fields.description: Safety inhibit status. Asserted whenever the controller must deassert actuator command validity.

fields.name: OPERATING_MODE
fields.description: Current operating mode reported by the safety monitor.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved. Reads as zero.

registers.name: MODEL_TRACE
registers.description: Traceability and freshness data for model request and response flow.

fields.name: REQUEST_TOKEN
fields.description: Most recent request token generated by the request scheduler.

fields.name: REQUEST_AGE
fields.description: Age of the current request, in cycles or an implementation-defined age unit consistent with the scheduler and safety monitor.

fields.name: RESPONSE_AGE
fields.description: Age of the last observed response, derived from the history buffer and used for stale-data detection.

registers.name: MODEL_REQUEST_WORD0
registers.description: Transparent capture of the lower 32 bits of the model-request payload for software analysis and traceability.

fields.name: MODEL_REQ_DATA_LO
fields.description: Lower 32 bits of model request data emitted by the request scheduler.

registers.name: MODEL_REQUEST_WORD1
registers.description: Transparent capture of the upper 32 bits of the model-request payload for software analysis and traceability.

fields.name: MODEL_REQ_DATA_HI
fields.description: Upper 32 bits of model request data emitted by the request scheduler.

registers.name: MODEL_RESPONSE_WORD0
registers.description: Transparent capture of the lower 32 bits of the model-response payload for software analysis and traceability.

fields.name: MODEL_RSP_DATA_LO
fields.description: Lower 32 bits of model response data observed by the transport bridge.

registers.name: MODEL_RESPONSE_WORD1
registers.description: Transparent capture of the upper 32 bits of the model-response payload for software analysis and traceability.

fields.name: MODEL_RSP_DATA_HI
fields.description: Upper 32 bits of model response data observed by the transport bridge.

registers.name: DEBUG_STATUS
registers.description: Additional firmware-visible status derived from the implemented controller state.

fields.name: MODEL_REQ_VALID
fields.description: Current model-request valid state driven toward the external model transport path.

fields.name: MODEL_REQ_READY
fields.description: Current model-request ready indication returned from the transport bridge.

fields.name: MODEL_RSP_VALID_SEEN
fields.description: Indicates that a model response valid pulse has been observed.

fields.name: MODEL_RSP_READY
fields.description: Model-response ready driven outward by the transport bridge.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_CMD_VALID
fields.description: Current actuator command validity.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved. Reads as zero.

init_sequence: Assert reset and wait for reset deassertion.
Program SPEED_WINDOW_MIN to 20 m/s and SPEED_WINDOW_MAX to 55 m/s unless a different validated envelope is required by the application.
Program ACTUATOR_BOUNDS to the safe firmware-approved actuator command limits.
Program TIMEOUT_CFG.TIMEOUT_CYCLES and MODEL_REQ_TTL to values appropriate for the external model response latency.
Write CTRL.OPERATING_MODE as required by the application and then set CTRL.ENABLE.
Optionally issue CTRL.CLEAR_FAULT as a write-one pulse after resolving the cause of a latched fault.
polling_sequence: Poll MODEL_TRACE.REQUEST_AGE and MODEL_TRACE.RESPONSE_AGE for freshness monitoring.
Read DEBUG_STATUS to observe model transport handshakes and actuator validity.
Read ACTUATOR_BOUNDS, SPEED_WINDOW_MIN, SPEED_WINDOW_MAX, and TIMEOUT_CFG as needed for diagnostics and software logging.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The register map is firmware-visible and reachable through the MMIO decode path described in the specification.
No fallback command, fallback register, fallback status, or substitute controller behavior is introduced.
Wide payload visibility for model transport is split across 32-bit words to match the implemented MMIO data width.
This map is compatible with the specified top-level MMIO ports and does not invent incompatible bus semantics.
